# Alpine

> Put afterburners on your team for the recurring work that drains their focus from the important things. The route is planned. Step by step, your people make the decisions and the adjustments, the heavy work is carried for them, and every step begins from what they corrected in the one before.

Alpine LTD, founded 2024, built in Bulgaria, clients worldwide, EU data residency on request. One page, seven chapters, English.

## The page

- [The work](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#work): the recurring work a team rebuilds by hand, and what changes when the route is planned.
- [The crew](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#crew): we are with you at each step; the three questions (how quickly we deliver, what your team has to learn, how sure you can be) with their answers.
- [The roots](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#roots): money, risk, control, speed.
- [The record](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#record): every correction your people make is kept, so nothing is corrected twice.
- [The hangar](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#hangar): the same discipline that keeps the software people depend on running, brought to the repetitive work nobody on your team wants and everybody ends up doing.
- [Talk to us](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#door): contact@alpine-engineering.eu
